acceptance: Every displayed cell traces to a Stata aggregate key/hash and stated source scope.
Axis/table labels show unit, year, denominator and observed/unavailable status.
The caption states a concrete finding only after execution; planned exhibit never implies a numerical result.
reader_sequence: Ask the everyday question in the title.
The quality report states what each problem prevents, rather than hiding problems inside a generic data-cleaning note.
Show the formula and define every symbol next to it.
Name the population, units, eligible N and unknown states.
State the main numerical finding only after calculation, then state the limit.

latex_outline.h1: What are we trying to learn?
latex_outline.lead_question: Start with the actual question and the data we can observe.

h2.title: Source states for every requested variable

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.purpose: Source states for every requested variable?
h3.formula: Partition each variable-year into observed valid, observed domain-invalid, structural absence, inapplicable, missing response, parse failure and unresolved semantics; counts must sum to source N.
h3.reader_explanation: An empty cell can have several causes; separating them prevents missing answers from becoming artificial zeros.

h2.title: Exact current source and rule versions

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.purpose: Exact current source and rule versions?
h3.formula: List input hash, annual rule hash, field locator and verification status for every quality variable.
h3.reader_explanation: The same variable name can mean different things in different years, so the evidence is attached to the annual rule.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: Count known positive, observed zero, invalid negative and missing capital stock; show each count/source N.
h3.reader_explanation: A recorded zero is not treated as a missing stock, and a missing stock is not evidence that the factory owns no capital.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: For stock_total-sum(all required stock components): N, mean=sum(x)/N, sample SD=sqrt(sum((x-mean)^2)/(N-1)), min, P1/P5/P25/P50/P75/P95/P99, max; retain zero/negative/missing counts.
h3.reader_explanation: A reconciliation gap identifies a definition or entry problem to investigate; partial component sums cannot validate a reported total.

latex_outline.lead_question: Show coverage, definitions and denominators before comparisons.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: Count valid observed capital additions by year; report missing 2015 source as unavailable, not all-zero additions.
h3.reader_explanation: Investment is a flow during the year. An unavailable source cannot tell us whether factories invested.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: Show separate stock, gross acquisition, disposal and net-addition definitions, their units and admissible signs.
h3.reader_explanation: The value of assets already owned and the value bought this year answer different questions.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: For each fuel classify quantity/cost pair as both known, quantity only, cost only, both absent, invalid or unresolved unit.
h3.reader_explanation: A fuel bill without a quantity cannot establish physical energy consumption.

h2.title: Fuel unit-price distributions and flagged tails

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.purpose: Fuel unit-price distributions and flagged tails?
h3.formula: For unit_price=cost_Rp000/quantity_in_verified_native_unit: N, mean=sum(x)/N, sample SD=sqrt(sum((x-mean)^2)/(N-1)), min, P1/P5/P25/P50/P75/P95/P99, max; retain zero/negative/missing counts.
h3.reader_explanation: Extreme unit prices may reveal quantity-unit or monetary-scale problems; they are flagged, not silently deleted.

latex_outline.h1: What do the main results mean?
latex_outline.lead_question: Explain the results in plain language after valid execution.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: For each fuel-year list raw quantity name, canonical name, native unit, conversion factor and retired alias.
h3.reader_explanation: The conversion is checked before quantities from different years are compared.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: Purchased electricity component states: PLN known, non-PLN known, both known, partial and absent.
h3.reader_explanation: Knowing one supplier does not necessarily reveal the factory’s full electricity purchases.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: Separate purchased, generated, own-used and sold kWh. Total end-use must not add generator fuel energy and generated electricity as two independent final uses.
h3.reader_explanation: Generating electricity changes the accounting boundary; the same energy should not be counted twice.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: Count complete energy, observed subtotal only, no usable component and unresolved-unit states by fixed component mask.
h3.reader_explanation: An observed subtotal tells us what is measured, not how much energy is missing.

latex_outline.lead_question: Separate legitimate sensitivity from primary definition.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: Count records affected by each factor source/version, carry assumption and unresolved physical unit.
h3.reader_explanation: A smooth emissions series can come from a carried assumption rather than newly observed annual evidence.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: For rd_expense_nominal, with activity and external-funding rates in separate panels: N, mean=sum(x)/N, sample SD=sqrt(sum((x-mean)^2)/(N-1)), min, P1/P5/P25/P50/P75/P95/P99, max; retain zero/negative/missing counts.
h3.reader_explanation: Spending on research, doing research and receiving outside research funding are three different concepts.

h2.title: R&D annual question and code meanings

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.purpose: R&D annual question and code meanings?
h3.formula: List each annual R&D question and code mapping; IRDVCU is an amount, COSTRD a funding code only where the original questionnaire proves it.
h3.reader_explanation: A numeric code is not a spending amount merely because it is stored as a number.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: Export status yes/no/unknown; known-response rate=100*yes/(yes+no); also show unknown/source N.
h3.reader_explanation: The export rate describes known answers; the unknown share shows what it leaves out.

latex_outline.lead_question: Keep unsupported source branches and interpretation limits visible.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: Cross-tabulate verified any-export and direct-export status, retaining unknown values as explicit cells.
h3.reader_explanation: A factory may export through an intermediary, so direct exporting and any exporting need not match.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: For export_value=verified_export_share_fraction*verified_matching_output_base: N, mean=sum(x)/N, sample SD=sqrt(sum((x-mean)^2)/(N-1)), min, P1/P5/P25/P50/P75/P95/P99, max; retain zero/negative/missing counts.
h3.reader_explanation: The implied value is only valid if the share refers to exactly the amount being multiplied.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: For output_nominal-production_nominal and their relative gap where both refer to documented comparable flows: N, mean=sum(x)/N, sample SD=sqrt(sum((x-mean)^2)/(N-1)), min, P1/P5/P25/P50/P75/P95/P99, max; retain zero/negative/missing counts.
h3.reader_explanation: A difference in wording can explain a numeric discrepancy; the larger amount is not automatically the right export denominator.

h2.title: Imported materials: value, zero and unknown

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.purpose: Imported materials: value, zero and unknown?
h3.formula: Imported-material status from verified value: positive, observed zero, invalid and unknown; imported share=imported_materials/materials_total only for a proven total.
h3.reader_explanation: Using imported materials and the imported share of materials are different summaries.

latex_outline.h1: Can another colleague reproduce and accept this row?
latex_outline.lead_question: End with audit able source-to-result path and exact completion checks.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: Show foreign ownership [0,100], exact 0 and 10 boundaries, any_foreign=(share>0), FDI10=(share>=10); unknown remains unknown.
h3.reader_explanation: The two indicators answer whether there is any foreign ownership and whether it reaches the stated 10% threshold.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: Report marginal failures for each requirement and sequential attrition in the frozen requirement order; final joint mask is their intersection.
h3.reader_explanation: The largest marginal problem need not remove the most additional observations after earlier requirements have already been applied.

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.formula: For each variable compare adjacent supplied-year N, verified share, median and P99; align documented definition changes and use actual calendar gap length.
h3.reader_explanation: A discontinuity is a prompt to check the survey definition and coverage before telling an economic story.

h2.title: Exception dispositions and exact row acceptance

h3.title: Intuition, calculation and meaning
h3.purpose: Exception dispositions and exact row acceptance?
h3.formula: Every flagged issue receives source evidence, affected variables/years, downstream gate and fixed/unresolved disposition; required failures keep G2 incomplete.
h3.reader_explanation: The quality report states what each problem prevents, rather than hiding problems inside a generic data-cleaning note.

repository_minimum_checks: For every variable/year, counts by all mutually exclusive missingness states sum to the source denominator.
Report original, accepted and flagged distributions with units; count negative, zero, upper-tail and exact-boundary cases.
Recompute selected accounting identities, share boundaries and export-value conversion from components.
Check quality masks do not use future treatment/outcome information and unknown joint statuses cannot become domestic/nontrading.
Link every exception class to source field/year, rule version, affected count and disposition; no undocumented deletion.
Refresh against the exact current G0 hash; newly corrected units/recodes and all eligibility decisions reconcile to that version.

operational_checks.criterion: All state partitions and masks reconcile
operational_checks.pass_rule: For every variable/year, states sum to N; all flagged exceptions trace; joint unknown never default zero.

operational_checks.criterion: Export value and capital/energy identities independently checked
operational_checks.pass_rule: Exactly defined source concepts/units; missing components unavailable; no unsupported denominator or stock substitution.
All 44 plans pass root validation and root records the freeze; no analytical execution before freeze.

operational_checks.criterion: Original request versus manager additions clearly separated
operational_checks.pass_rule: Exact source.request/strategy/notes/number/PIC/completion unchanged; repository minimum checks labelled repository-authored, not DOC X quotation.

operational_checks.criterion: Independent row entrypoint with nested modules
operational_checks.pass_rule: Runrows/G2/G2.do from clean configured local environment without master; same full precision numeric results; all local dependencies documented.

operational_checks.criterion: Every required report section has meaning and formula
operational_checks.pass_rule: Every H 1/H 2/H 3 sectionstatesquestion, intuition, equation and symbols, visual/table, plain meaning and limit; reviewer can explain without code.

operational_checks.criterion: All company analysis descends from the single published consolidated master.
operational_checks.pass_rule: Every company-data operand in analysis must be the single published consolidated master or a declared derivative whose entire company-data ancestry ends at that consolidated master. Direct annual-wave reads are prohibited in analysis; only the master builder may append annual waves. Raw/staged/legacy/cached final company files cannot be numerical analysis parents. A required field missing from the wave is an upstream preparation failure; never repair it by opening an external company file inside this row. Comparison-only validators may read older data but may not feed construction or estimates. External reference and metadata inputs retain explicit non-company roles.

operational_checks.criterion: Readable non-executable comments and verified live progress at every nesting level.
operational_checks.pass_rule: Meet code_readability_and_progress_contract without changing the statistical results or control flow.

definition_of_done.reader_gate: An intelligent lay reader can state the question, what was counted/compared, each equation symbol, finding and limit without consulting code. Each section follows intuition → formula with every symbol → visual/table → plain meaning → boundary.
definition_of_done.visual_gate: Use custom vector charts from saved full-precision Stata aggregates, professional restrained publication typography, direct labels, meaningful color, clear units, visible missing 2016 gap, robust legends and notes. No default Stata graph in final delivery. Inspect every PDF page at reading size for overlap/clipping and all captions/axis labels. Distribution intervals are never labelled confidence intervals.
definition_of_done.numerical_gate: Independently recompute control counts/formulas against frozen aggregates/source receipts, exact categorical reconciliations, finite domains, and displayed rounding. Every chart/table value has a source table key/hash. No analytic calculations in for matting Python.
definition_of_done.source_scope_gate: The exact DOCX row and every repository minimum check must be satisfied on the declared actual data scope. Source absence remains a blocker where necessary; a readable PDF, synthetic passing run or existing column does not waive real-panel/WPI/source requirements.

dataflow_protocol.input_integrity: Physical source data and source-definition evidence are separate declared inputs. Pin both before transforming a value.
dataflow_protocol.join_keys: Never merge by row order. Use declared keys and assert intended 1:1, m:1 or explicitly weighted 1:m cardinality; record unmatched and duplicate rows.
dataflow_protocol.source_rows: source_year/source_row identifies a row within the frozen canonical source family, not a longitudinal plant. If another source family is added, source_file_hash is part of the raw key until the canonical manifest proves uniqueness.
dataflow_protocol.branch_status: Each branch produces either a validated state or a typed unsupported receipt with the missing prerequisite. Unsupported receipts are not numeric datasets and cannot satisfy a required input gate.
dataflow_protocol.missing_states: Source absence, inapplicable questionnaire universe, parse failure, unknown unit, masked identifier, observed zero and valid positive/negative values remain distinguishable.
dataflow_protocol.downstream_gate: Only a passed input contract may unlock its dependent statistical branch. Publishing a diagnostic about a blocked branch does not complete the Word row.

plan_revision.scope: Input boundary, readable code comments and hierarchical execution visibility; exact original Word request and statistical plan retained.
plan_revision.implementation_status: This revision does not execute this assignment row.

code_readability_and_progress_contract.comments: Non-executable Stata comments explain purpose, actual inputs, outputs and failure checks at file, block and subblock levels in simple Indonesian. Do not invent scientific interpretations.
code_readability_and_progress_contract.runtime: Every file, block, subblock, iteration and deepest step prints start, finish or explicit early/error outcome, x/X, percent, elapsed time and exact location; stream live and save the same log.
code_readability_and_progress_contract.clock: Date-aware native Stata wall clock, one-second resolution; preserve scientific timers and fail certification on backward clock.
code_readability_and_progress_contract.semantics: Original operative source remains exactly recoverable; verify r(), e(), _rc, conditional branches and early transfers with a constructed runtime fixture before company execution.
code_readability_and_progress_contract.rerun: A documented launcher must run the actual preparation with visible progress before declaring data prep ready.

wave_input_contract.rule: Every company-data operand in analysis must be the single published consolidated master or a declared derivative whose entire company-data ancestry ends at that consolidated master. Direct annual-wave reads are prohibited in analysis; only the master builder may append annual waves. Raw/staged/legacy/cached final company files cannot be numerical analysis parents. A required field missing from the wave is an upstream preparation failure; never repair it by opening an external company file inside this row. Comparison-only validators may read older data but may not feed construction or estimates. External reference and metadata inputs retain explicit non-company roles.
wave_input_contract.input_release_status: Not certified until actual build, value comparisons and read-boundary checks pass.
wave_input_contract.scientific_gates: All existing field-specific, identity, unit, price, scope and source gates remain binding.

execution_input_policy.finalisation_input: explicit local accepted G0; exact parent checksum required
execution_input_policy.panel_rule: Development accepts declared synthetic_development psid with firm-year uniqueness; actual requires verified real linkage. obs_id and annual clusters are not firm keys.
